thought.text: The non-interactive shell lacks the mise shims on PATH. Let me set up the environment properly.

reasoning_content: `bin/rails` uses `ruby` from the mise shim on PATH, but my non-interactive bash doesn't source mise. The devcontainer's PATH includes `/home/vscode/.local/share/mise/shims`. I need to set the PATH to include the mise shims and the user's environment.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
export PATH="/home/vscode/.local/share/mise/shims:/home/vscode/.local/share/mise/installs/node/24.22.0/bin:$PATH"
which ruby node
cd /workspaces/workspace
RAILS_ENV=development timeout 180 bin/rails runner "
include ViteRuby::ViteTypescriptTagHelper
class H
  include ViteRuby::ViteTypescriptTagHelper
  include ActionView::Helpers::AssetTagHelper
  def self.build; new
  end
end
" 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== simpler: grep vite_ruby proxy config ==="
grep -rn "vite_ruby\|ViteRuby" config/initializers/ 2>/dev/null | head -5
' 2>&1
